### *Acquisition will expand distribution capacity and strengthen service capabilities across key California markets*


BOISE, Idaho – November 5, 2026 – Boise Cascade Company (“Boise Cascade” or the “Company”) (NYSE: BCC) today announced it intends to acquire two building materials distribution facilities from Taiga Building Products in Rocklin and Sanger, California.


The acquisition will expand Boise Cascade’s distribution capacity and strengthen its ability to serve customers throughout Northern and Central California, the California Coast, and Northern Nevada. Boise Cascade currently operates 39 distribution locations in the U.S., and the Rocklin and Sanger facilities will further extend the Company’s distribution presence in California. The acquisition will also enhance the Company’s general line product capabilities and support the continued growth of its recently expanded partnership with James Hardie®.


“This acquisition is a great fit for our business and an exciting next step in our growth strategy,” said Jo Barney, Executive Vice President of Boise Cascade’s Building Materials Distribution division. “These locations complement our existing operations in California, and we’re excited about the opportunities this expansion will create for our customers and our business. I look forward to welcoming the Taiga team to Boise Cascade.”


“We’re proud of the businesses and relationships our teams have built in Rocklin and Sanger,” said Russell Permann, President and Chief Executive Officer of Taiga. “Boise Cascade has a strong reputation in building materials distribution, and we look forward to seeing these locations and teams begin their next chapter at Boise Cascade.”


The transaction is expected to close by mid-November 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Taiga’s other locations and products are not included in the transaction and will continue to be owned and operated by Taiga.

**About Boise Cascade** Boise Cascade is one of the largest U.S. wholesale distributors of building materials and a leading manufacturer of engineered wood products and plywood in North America. Our integrated model and national distribution footprint position us to deliver outstanding service to our customers across a broad range of industry-leading products, including key structural products that we produce. Headquartered in Boise, Idaho, we operate more than 60 distribution and manufacturing facilities strategically located across the U.S. and Canada. Our work is powered by a dedicated team of over 7,500 people. For more information, visit:[Boise Cascade | Our Company](https://www.bc.com/company/)
